description: This JavaScript script is designed to synchronize a Prisma schema with the database without creating migrations. It manages environment variables for database configuration, parses MySQL URLs, and executes the Prisma CLI command to push schema changes, serving as a utility for database synchronization in an e-commerce platform project.

methods.name: ensureDatabaseUrl()
methods.description: Constructs and returns the DATABASE_URL environment variable from existing variables or a URL, parsing MySQL URLs if necessary.

methods.name: safeMaskUrl(url)
methods.description: Returns a masked version of the database URL for logging purposes, obscuring sensitive credentials.

methods.name: runPrismaDbPush()
methods.description: Executes the Prisma CLI command to push the schema to the database, including handling platform differences.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Coordinates the process by ensuring the database URL is set, then running the Prisma push command, with error handling.
